content:
Reach Bangladesh’s development and humanitarian professionals without compromising the independence they rely on.

Options

  • Featured job listings and recruitment campaigns
  • Featured funding opportunities
  • Event promotion
  • Newsletter sponsorship
  • Clearly labelled sponsored content
  • Research and data partnerships
  • Institutional memberships

Our rules

  • All paid content is labelled and kept separate from editorial content.
  • Advertisers and partners do not get editorial coverage, approval rights or advance sight of our reporting.
  • We may decline any advertising that conflicts with our standards.

Get in touch to discuss a partnership.
